title: Cubic Equation
summary: Newton for one real root, then the quadratic factor. ~70 bytes.

body.text: HK listings of a full Cardano cubic are ~126 bytes and need CMPLX. This compact exam version asks for A, B, C, D and an initial guess M, Newton-iterates to a real root, then deflates to a quadratic and prints the other two roots. Stop Newton when |f| drops below 10⁻⁷.

body.label: Memory / run mode
body.text: ~70 bytes of the shared 680-byte pool. Create the slot in COMP; CMPLX if the quadratic factor has complex roots. Type ? → : ◢ Goto Lbl If Then from SHIFT 3 (P-CMD).

body.caption: x³ − 6x² + 11x − 6 = (x−1)(x−2)(x−3). Guess M = 0 walks to the root 1, then 2 and 3.

body.text: Question: Use this program to solve the case: x³ − 6x² + 11x − 6 = 0.
Example 2: Guess near a different root
Question: Use this program to solve the case: Guess near a different root.
Given: Same polynomial, guess M = 5 walks to 3 first.

items: Pauses 3, then 1 and 2 (order of the last two follows the quadratic formula)

body.text: Question: Use this program to solve the case: x³ + x = 0 → 0, ±i.
Given: A,B,C,D = 1, 0, 1, 0. Guess 0. The quadratic is x² + 1. Run the slot in CMPLX to print ±i.

items: First root 0. Next pauses: i and −i (R<=>I). In COMP you get Math ERROR on √(−1)

body.label: Pitfalls
body.text: 10^(−7) is the Newton stop. If f′(M) = 0 Newton hits Math ERROR — try another guess. A published Cardano listing (~126 bytes, CMPLX) prints all three roots without a guess.
